title: Haji Duo Tournament
tagline: Two operators. One raid. The duo that extracts the most loot moves on.
rules: Duos only: two registered players per team. No substitutes after the bracket is locked.
Every round is head-to-head. Both duos run one raid on the map the organizer sets, in the same time window.
Score is the total value of loot both players extract, read from the end-of-raid summary, in Koen.
A player who dies or fails to extract scores 0. If both die, the duo is wiped and scores 0.
The higher score advances. An exact tie is settled by a rerun on the same map.
Both players post a screenshot of their end-of-raid summary in the results channel within 15 minutes of extracting.
Queue within 10 minutes of your scheduled raid time, or forfeit the round.
No cheats, exploits, or teaming with the opposing duo. Breaking this means disqualification.
Starting loadout value is capped at 300,000 Koen per player (placeholder; organizer confirms).
